pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-angular dark regions characterized by sharp edge transitions and jagged pixel gradients. Spatial area of patches is significantly larger on the cervical region compared to the smaller, fragmented patches appearing on the lower posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral plane, maintaining a high contrast ratio against the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper cervical line displays a dense, low-amplitude serrated profile with high-frequency jagged peaks visible against the background.
